The inclusion of income added 0.43p (≈0.13%), while valuing debt at fair value boosted NAV by 5.91p (≈1.78%) versus the undiluted basis, implying the market value of the trust's debt is below par and producing a modest positive adjustment to shareholders' net asset backing.
